meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 为你的 agent 接入 Dial 通道：拷贝并注册 Dial 适配器与配对助手、装好依赖、跑构建和注册测试，最终让 agent 用一个真实电话号码收发短信、接听 AI 语音来电。
howto.when: 当你要求给 agent 添加 Dial 号码、短信或语音通道时触发；安装过程会引导你登录 Dial（邮箱验证码或复用已有账号），并选择谁能给这条线发消息。

say.text: 给这个 agent 加一条 Dial 电话号码通道
say.note: 它会拷贝适配器、装依赖并跑构建与测试

say.text: 用我已有的 Dial 账号接入，不重新注册
say.note: 选择复用已登录账号，跳过邮箱验证码

say.text: 这条线只允许我自己发消息
say.note: 未知发件人策略设为 owner/strict

howto.what_en: Adds a Dial channel: it copies and registers the Dial adapter and pairing helper, installs pinned deps, builds, and runs the registration test — giving your agent a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Dial phone number, SMS, or AI voice channel to the agent. Setup walks you through Dial sign-in (email code or an existing account) and who may text the line.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number channel to this agent
say_en.note: It copies the adapter, installs deps, then builds and tests

say_en.text: Connect using my existing Dial account
say_en.note: Reuses the signed-in account, skipping the email code

say_en.text: Only allow me to text this line
say_en.note: Sets the unknown-sender policy to owner/strict
